CustomField.label: Progress Percent
CustomField.description: How far along this single requirement is, 0-100. Numeric items are Current/Target capped at 100; Checkbox items are 0 or 100. Deliberately a Number rather than a Percent field: percent fields are rescaled when referenced from other formulas, which would silently break Weighted_Progress__c.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISPICKVAL(Measure_Type__c, "Numeric"), IF( NULLVALUE(Target_Value__c, 0) > 0, MIN(100, NULLVALUE(Current_Value__c, 0) / Target_Value__c * 100), 0 ), IF(Completed__c, 100, 0) )
